# Test Before You Build

> Customer validation through 20 interviews with realistic potential customers before a major development investment.

Test Before You Build helps founders, companies, and research teams examine whether a product, service, software concept, or research-based innovation addresses a commercially meaningful customer problem. The fixed-price Idea Validation Sprint costs €2,900 + VAT and ends with a BUILD, CHANGE, or KILL recommendation.

Service provider: Dr. Kari Jääskeläinen, entrepreneur, business leader, and customer validation consultant with experience from around 200 commercialization and business development projects.

- [Business idea validation guide in Markdown](https://testbeforeyoubuild.com/how-to-validate-a-business-idea/index.md): Text equivalent of the business idea validation guide.
- [Market validation: process, methods and examples](https://testbeforeyoubuild.com/market-validation/): Guide to market validation definitions, method selection, evidence quality and decision-making.
- [Market validation guide in Markdown](https://testbeforeyoubuild.com/market-validation/index.md): Text equivalent of the market validation guide.
- [B2B customer research and participant recruitment](https://testbeforeyoubuild.com/b2b-customer-research/): Guide to defining, finding, screening and recruiting relevant B2B interview participants.
- [B2B customer research guide in Markdown](https://testbeforeyoubuild.com/b2b-customer-research/index.md): Text equivalent of the B2B customer research guide.
- [Customer discovery interviews: questions, process and evidence](https://testbeforeyoubuild.com/customer-discovery-interviews/): Guide to interview design, neutral questions, evidence analysis and decision-making.
- [Customer discovery interviews guide in Markdown](https://testbeforeyoubuild.com/customer-discovery-interviews/index.md): Text equivalent of the customer discovery interviews guide.
- [How to validate a SaaS idea before building an MVP](https://testbeforeyoubuild.com/how-to-validate-a-saas-idea/): Guide to testing SaaS problems, buyers, purchase paths, concepts and commitments before development.
- [SaaS idea validation guide in Markdown](https://testbeforeyoubuild.com/how-to-validate-a-saas-idea/index.md): Text equivalent of the SaaS validation guide.
- [How to test willingness to pay before you build](https://testbeforeyoubuild.com/how-to-test-willingness-to-pay/): Guide to current costs, pricing evidence, offers, pilots, buying authority and real commitments.
- [Willingness-to-pay guide in Markdown](https://testbeforeyoubuild.com/how-to-test-willingness-to-pay/index.md): Text equivalent of the willingness-to-pay guide.

- [Customer interview bias: leading questions and other mistakes](https://testbeforeyoubuild.com/customer-interview-bias/): Guide to selection, wording, interviewer, confirmation and analysis bias in customer research.
- [Customer interview bias guide in Markdown](https://testbeforeyoubuild.com/customer-interview-bias/index.md): Text equivalent of the customer interview bias guide.
- [How many customer interviews are enough?](https://testbeforeyoubuild.com/how-many-customer-interviews/): Evidence-based guide to interview sample size, information sufficiency and project scoping.
